title: 第11章 黑篮完结篇第12章 番外赤司篇
content_zh:
第11章 黑篮完结篇
原田微笑着听着黄濑说话，时不时地点点头附和。但实际上，他耳鸣的厉害，只能模模糊糊知道黄濑在说话，却完全不知道内容是什么。
眨眨眼，黄濑的面容也看不太清了呢…
请再给我一点时间，我还有好多话没有和大家说，还想多看看他们熟悉的脸…
原田没有发现黄濑早就停下了，呆呆的看着他仍旧浑然不觉的挂着微笑，点头。
黄濑颤抖着手抓住他的肩膀，声音里透着无法掩饰的恐慌。
“小律，你怎么了，你别吓我好不好？”
而原田感受到了肩膀上的温度，但是他听不清也看不清，只能茫然无措的抬起头看着他。
黄濑匆忙叫来了医生，经过大量的检查过后，就连医生也觉的不可思议。
“内脏严重破损，视力、听力衰退，即使再怎么救治，也活不过一星期了。”
黄濑听后第一个反应并不是悲伤，而是茫然。
怎么会？这怎么可能？
这样的病体不可能产生于一朝一夕，而之前的一个月，自己都在享受着原田对自己无微不至的照料，他怎么可能会死呢？
难道他，一直拖着这样破败的身体，为了他四处奔波吗？
这让他怎么能相信，又怎么愿意去面对……
恍惚的看向静静地坐在椅子上的少年，那个自己刚刚才发觉有些喜欢上了的少年，竟然就要这样死去了吗？
不，这不是真的！
他跌跌撞撞的走过去将原田抱在怀里，力气大的勒的原田有些呼吸困难。
就在我已经痊愈，可以和你一起重回赛场的时候，却被告知你就要死了。既然注定要在地狱，就让他一直在地狱里好了。为什么要在他以为自己到了天堂的时候，再告诉他这不过是一场虚无缥缈的梦？
你就要永远的离开我，在我最幸福的时刻。

原田从抱紧自己的力道中察觉到了黄濑不断翻涌的激烈情绪，便没有挣动，只是安静的待着，手轻轻的在他的背上安慰般的拍着。
而相拥的两人都没有注意到，门外赤司一动不动的站着，不知道已经站了多久。
原田住院的消息很快传了出去，每天来看望的同学一批又一批，大家都希望原田能够早日康复。
是的，因为原田的请求，黄濑和赤司并没有将原田其实已经回天乏术的事实告诉众人，比起在大家的悲伤中离开，他宁愿不要惊动任何人。
在这最后的时间中，黄濑和赤司时时刻刻都陪在他身边。即使到后来原田已经完全失去了视觉和听觉，他也能在漆黑而无声的世界中感受到他们的气息。
虽然听不见了，但是触觉还在。黄濑和赤司会慢慢的一笔一划的在他的手心慢慢书写，如果原田摇头，就放慢速度再写一遍。
由此他也知道了很多原来不知道的事，比如说赤司也会削苹果，黄濑是个管家婆。
这样的日子，原田虽然看不到他们的脸，听不到他们的声音，但是他们无微不至的照料让原田从未感受到恐惧和孤单，在离开这个世界之前能够和他们在一起，真的很幸福。
第五个夜晚，东京迎来了今年的第一场大雪。
而原田在这一天晚上无声无息的离去，那双茶色的眸子不会再睁开。
作者有话要说：
之后某千会给大家献上番外。番外里会有回来的伏笔的~
content_en:
Chapter 11 The End of Black Basket
Harada listened to Kise's words with a smile, nodding in agreement from time to time. But in fact, his tinnitus was so severe that he could only vaguely understand that Kise was talking, but had no idea what the content was.
After blinking, Kise's face couldn't be clearly seen...
Please give me a little more time. I still have a lot to say to you, and I also want to see more of their familiar faces...
Harada didn't realize that Kise had stopped a long time ago, and stared blankly at him, still smiling and nodding without realizing it.
Kise grabbed his shoulders with trembling hands, unable to conceal the panic in his voice.
"Xiao Lu, what's wrong with you? Please don't scare me, okay?"
Harada felt the warmth on his shoulders, but he couldn't hear or see clearly. He could only look up at him blankly.
Kise hurriedly called the doctor. After a lot of examinations, even the doctor found it incredible.
"The internal organs are severely damaged, the eyesight and hearing are declining, and no matter how much treatment is given, he will not survive for more than a week."
Kise's first reaction after hearing this was not sadness, but confusion.
How could it be? How is this possible?
Such a disease could not have occurred overnight. In the previous month, he had enjoyed Harada's meticulous care for him. How could he die?
Could it be that he has been dragging such a dilapidated body around all the time for him?
How could he believe this, and how could he be willing to face it...
He looked at the young man sitting quietly on the chair in a daze. Was the young man that he just realized he had fallen in love with just now going to die like this?
No, this is not true!
He stumbled over and held Harada in his arms. He strangled Harada so hard that it was difficult to breathe.
Just when I had recovered and could return to the game with you, I was told that you were going to die. Since he is destined to be in hell, let him stay in hell. Why tell him that this was just an illusory dream when he thought he was in heaven?
You will leave me forever, in my happiest moment.
Harada noticed Kise's intense emotions surging from the strength of his embrace, so he didn't move. He just stayed quietly and patted his back gently with his hand in a comforting way.
The two people hugging each other didn't notice that Akashi stood motionless outside the door. They didn't know how long they had been standing there.
The news that Harada was hospitalized spread quickly, and batches of classmates came to visit every day. Everyone hoped that Harada could recover as soon as possible.
Yes, because of Harada's request, Kise and Akashi did not tell everyone the fact that Harada had no chance of saving his life. Rather than leave in everyone's sorrow, he would rather not alert anyone.
In these last moments, Kise and Akashi were by his side every moment. Even though Harada later completely lost his vision and hearing, he could still feel their presence in the dark and silent world.
Although the hearing is gone, the touch is still there. Kise and Akashi would slowly write on his palm one stroke at a time. If Harada shook his head, he would slow down and write again.
From this, he also learned a lot of things that he didn't know before, such as Akaashi can also peel apples and Kise is a housekeeper.
On days like this, although Harada couldn't see their faces or hear their voices, their meticulous care made Harada never feel fear or loneliness. He was really happy to be with them before leaving this world.
On the fifth night, Tokyo received its first heavy snowfall of the year.
And Harada left silently that night, and those brown eyes would never open again.
